value.rationale: This is an exact finite optimal-landmark relocation benchmark on the canonical smallest four-regular triangle-free four-chromatic graph. Its two unique slide centers, four-move maximum local detour and contrasting self-centered jump network identify a nontrivial mobility asymmetry; the full 10,585-pair spectrum supports rigorous testing of shortest-move methods. No general theorem is required for this natural complete finite classification.
